gameDescriptionHtml:
Explore the beautiful forest and live your life as Bigfoot. Catch and eat fish, insects, and other creatures. You are the unseen guardian of the forest. Forage the forest for mushrooms, berries, and more. Build shelters to store your items in to get through the harsh winters. Prove yourself as guardian of the forest and unlock special rewards through challenges. Acquire new Bigfoot Skills like Bigfoot Vision, Speed, Portals, and Strength. Watch out for human Bigfoot hunters. They will be trying to find you and photograph you. Steal their items to earn points and complete tasks.

Game Features

  • Custom design the look of your Bigfoot you play with in the game.
  • Freedom to explore the forest however you like.
  • Features three modes, Normal, Survival, and Free Roam.
  • Catch fish, insects, and other creatures to eat.
  • Drink water from lakes and streams.
  • Forage for mushrooms, berries, and more.
  • Build shelters to store your items and sleep in.
  • Acquire Bigfoot Skills like Bigfoot Vision, Speed, Portals, and Strength.
  • Use Bigfoot Healing to heal injured animals.
  • Prove yourself as guardian of the forest and unlock special rewards through challenges.
  • Human Bigfoot Hunters that try to photograph you and prove your existence.
  • Steal human items for more points.
  • Dynamic weather, experience the forest in all seasons.
  • Become friends with a human.
  • Find and interact with other Bigfoot.
  • Level up and eventually find and attract a mate for Bigfoot.
